bookLearningFrameworkPrompt.purpose: Build the complete learning dataset for any authorized book. Process the entire source. One chunk is one JSON file.

sourceRules.rule: Preserve English exactly in sentences[].en. Never rewrite, simplify, modernize, correct, normalize, or paraphrase.
Every source sentence appears exactly once.

chunking.rule: Each chunk contains 10-20 complete source sentences.
Split at natural sentence and discussion boundaries.
Each chunk has ONE coherent, specific theme derived from its actual sentences.
Do not mix unrelated subjects just to fill a chunk.
Use precise thematicTopicId values, e.g. topic_fadak for a Fadak passage.

requiredSchema.topLevelFields: bookId, id, examType, title, thematicTopicId, difficultyLevelId, sourceSectionId, sourceSectionTitle, sentences, glossary, questions

sentenceObject.rule: All four are mandatory and non-empty.
en is exact source; ur and fa are faithful translations; ar is faithful Modern Standard Arabic with full tashkeel.
Preserve Qur'anic Arabic inside ﴿ ﴾ and hadith quotations inside « » when applicable.

glossaryObject.rule: 8-30 useful terms actually occurring in the chunk.
glossaryObject.categories: gloss_noun, gloss_verb, gloss_proper_noun, gloss_quranic_term, gloss_religious_term, gloss_adjective, gloss_adverb, gloss_phrase

questionObject.requiredFields: id, type, typeId, question, answer, explanationEn, explanationUr, explanationFa, explanationAr
questionObject.rule: 3-8 questions based only on the chunk.

mcq.rule: answer exactly matches the correct choice.

metadataRules.rule: thematicTopicId resolves to the book's thematicTopics.
sourceSectionId resolves to the book's sections in manifest.json.
sourceSectionTitle preserves the original source heading.
difficultyLevelId is diff_easy, diff_medium, or diff_hard.
examType is one of religious-studies, gcse, islamic-studies, reading-comprehension, literature, history, philosophy.

idRules.rule: Stable unique chunk IDs based on book, section, theme, sequence.
Question IDs use -q1, -q2; MCQ choices use -c1, -c2.

qualityRules.rule: Never leave ur, fa, or ar null or empty.
Do not invent claims, glossary terms, questions, or themes.
Keep names, quotations, dates, religious terminology, and historical details accurate.

output.rule: Return exactly one valid JSON object per chunk file. No markdown wrapper.

validation.check: Non-empty en, ur, fa, ar for every sentence.

exampleShape.json: { "bookId":"peshawar-nights", "id":"pn-s8-fadak-02", "examType":"religious-studies", "title":"The Confiscation of Fadak", "thematicTopicId":"topic_fadak", "difficultyLevelId":"diff_medium", "sourceSectionId":"section_8", "sourceSectionTitle":"ARGUMENT FROM HADITH 'LA NURIS'", "sentences":[{"en":"Exact source sentence.","ur":"وفادار اردو ترجمہ۔","fa":"ترجمهٔ دقیق فارسی.","ar":"تَرْجَمَةٌ عَرَبِيَّةٌ دَقِيقَةٌ بِالتَّشْكِيلِ."}], "glossary":[{"en":"term","ur":"اردو","fa":"فارسی","ar":"الْعَرَبِيَّةُ","categoryId":"gloss_noun"}], "questions":[{"id":"pn-s8-fadak-02-q1","type":"short","typeId":"q_short","question":"Question based on the chunk?","answer":"Answer based on the chunk.","explanationEn":"Text-grounded explanation.","explanationUr":"متن پر مبنی اردو وضاحت۔","explanationFa":"توضیح فارسی مبتنی بر متن.","explanationAr":"شَرْحٌ مُسْتَنِدٌ إِلَى النَّصِّ بِالتَّشْكِيلِ."}] }
